checkpoint_selection: Export after exactly 240/480 completed optimizer updates; finish training and exit before loading validation models. Select on 32 full validation tasks: zero available-exchange return errors, minimum success rate across available exchanges/fallback/handoff, overall success, fewer repeated-field attempts, then lower validation loss. No test inference before selection.
runtime_policy: Previous adapter old vs new flow separates engineering; previous vs new adapter under the identical v4 flow measures the bundled training recipe. Base + v4 is a quality comparator. All arms use greedy unconstrained generation and eight total model calls.
promotion_rule: V4 overall, exchange completion, fallback and handoff success must each be at least both new-flow comparators; repeated field attempts lower than previous_new_flow; zero available-exchange return attempts; all confirmation invariants. No claim of production readiness.
